en.title: What predict_proba Really Means: Probability Calibration Explained
en.subtitle: A score between 0 and 1 is only a probability if the model is calibrated. Check it with a calibration curve and fix it with CalibratedClassifierCV.

ar-EG.title: ليه الـ predict_proba مش احتمال حقيقي؟ يعني إيه Calibration
ar-EG.subtitle: الـ score اللي بين 0 و1 مابيبقاش احتمال غير لو الموديل calibrated. اكشف عليه بـ calibration curve، وصلّحه بـ CalibratedClassifierCV.

sources.title: Niculescu-Mizil and Caruana, Predicting Good Probabilities With Supervised Learning (ICML 2005)
Guo et al., On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks (ICML 2017)
